title: The Wild Salt
author: Emrys Thackeray
blurb: Ada Zhou, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
